🛡️ Reviews up or money back

We only win if your reviews grow.

Wear your badge for 30 days. If your Google reviews haven't grown, you get a full refund — no hoops, no argument. We're betting on the product.

  1. Wear and use your badge for 30 days after it arrives.
  2. Note your Google review count when you start and when the 30 days are up.
  3. If reviews didn't grow, email us the before/after numbers and your order details.
  4. We refund in full — no argument. Approved refunds go out within 14 business days.
  5. Return shipping on the badge itself is covered by the customer.
Questions

Before you order.

What happens to my logo and business info once I send it?
It's used only to design and program your badge. We don't share it with anyone else, and it's not used for anything beyond producing your order.
How long does it take to receive my badge?
Most orders are designed, printed, and shipped within a week of us receiving your details.
Does it work with any phone?
Yes — it works with any NFC-enabled smartphone (which covers the vast majority of phones made in the last several years). No app required.
Can I change the design after I order?
Reach out before we print and we're happy to make adjustments. Once printed, changes require a new order.
What if the badge reel breaks or the NFC stops working?
We replace defective hardware free of charge within 90 days. Just send a photo and we'll ship a new one.
Can the badge link to something other than Google reviews?
Yes. We can program it to any URL — your website, booking page, Yelp, or a custom landing page. Just tell us when you order.
